metadata.authority: Directorate of QA Automation & Security Compliance
metadata.methodology: Microsoft STRIDE & Carnegie Mellon DREAD Quantitative Threat Modeling

threat_vectors.title: Rogue Agent API & Model Impersonation
threat_vectors.target_component: MCP Service Mesh & API Ingress Proxy
threat_vectors.attack_description: Adversary crafts fraudulent agent identity headers or replays MCP session tokens to execute unauthorized commerce orders.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Mutual TLS (mTLS) with FIPS 140-3 cryptographic x509 cert validation and ephemeral nonces.

threat_vectors.title: DNS & Metadata Endpoint Spoofing (SSRF)
threat_vectors.attack_description: Adversary redirects outbound agent network requests to internal cloud metadata IP (169.254.169.254) to harvest instance credentials.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Air-gapped zero-egress NetworkPolicy (egress: []) and local DNS blackholing for link-local ranges.

threat_vectors.title: Pre-Commit & Build-Time Test Invariant Tampering
threat_vectors.attack_description: Adversary modifies CI test suites to delete security checks or bypass invariant assertions before production release.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Fail-closed INVARIANT_TEST_PRESERVATION gate; git hooks reject any commit deleting existing tests.

threat_vectors.title: Software Supply Chain Package Contamination
threat_vectors.attack_description: Adversary injects malicious backdoors into unpinned third-party packages or typosquatted upstream dependencies.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Strict hash-pinned requirements.txt, SLSA Level 3 provenance, and dual SPDX/CycloneDX cryptographic SBOM verification.

threat_vectors.title: Dispute Denial & Transaction Log Erasure
threat_vectors.attack_description: Disputing merchant denies transactional commitments or attempts to alter SQLite/PostgreSQL ledger records post-settlement.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Append-only cryptographic double-entry ledgers with SHA-256 rolling block seals and statutory FIRA tracking.

threat_vectors.title: Security Incident Telemetry Tampering
threat_vectors.attack_description: Adversary attempts to manipulate security metric values or falsify Big-4 compliance audit evidence records.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Immutable telemetry payloads signed with SHA-256 cryptographic digests verified against disk evidence binders.

threat_vectors.title: Accidental Secret & API Key Leakage in Commits
threat_vectors.attack_description: Developer or autonomous coding agent accidentally commits raw Stripe, AWS, or GitHub secret tokens to repo.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Pre-commit AST screening with Shannon entropy tripwire (H >= 4.2 bits/char) blocking commits synchronously.

threat_vectors.title: Volatile Memory Remanence & Container Escape Slicing
threat_vectors.attack_description: Post-execution worker process dumps unencrypted customer payload data from residual RAM buffers.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Ephemeral tmpfs RAM-disk mounting with NIST SP 800-88 Rev 1 & DoD 5220.22-M 3-pass crypto-shredding on exit.

threat_vectors.title: AST Parsing Recursion Bomb Stack Exhaustion
threat_vectors.attack_description: Adversary provides deeply nested arithmetic expressions (>50 levels) causing thread stack overflow and service crash.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: AST recursion limiter strictly enforcing maximum nesting depth <= 30; raises controlled catchable exceptions.

threat_vectors.title: Catastrophic ReDoS Regex Backtracking CPU Freeze
threat_vectors.attack_description: Adversary injects 1,500+ character repetitive string triggering exponential regex backtracking and 100% CPU lock.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Linear DFA non-backtracking regular expressions benchmarking in <0.05ms (ceiling: 1.0ms).

threat_vectors.title: Container Breakout & Host Filesystem Write Hijack
threat_vectors.attack_description: Malicious payload exploits container flaw to gain root access (UID 0) and modify host OS binaries.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Enforced non-root execution (UID 10001:10001), read-only rootfs (read_only: true), and capability drop ALL.

threat_vectors.title: Autonomous Agent Shell Execution & Table Destruction
threat_vectors.attack_description: Autonomous coding agent executes destructive shell command patterns (`rm -rf /`, `DROP TABLE`) during automated debugging.
threat_vectors.mitigation_mechanism: Kernel-adjacent command safety shims intercepting destructive patterns (<2ms); requires admin OTP override.
